notes.angle: Quản lý VPS Linux chuẩn giao diện desktop mượt mà trực tiếp từ máy cá nhân qua SSH/SFTP thuần, hoàn toàn không cần cài agent hay mở port web panel như giải pháp truyền thống.

facts.fact: Không mở thêm port lạ và không dùng web panel; kết nối thẳng bằng SSH key và đưa người dùng vào giao diện desktop.
facts.quote: No login screen, no web panel: Davish connects to the server you used last with your SSH key and puts you on its desktop. Nothing extra listens on the server, so there is no new port to open or protect.

facts.fact: Minh bạch lệnh thực thi: mọi thao tác can thiệp hệ thống đều hiển thị trước câu lệnh chính xác và lưu vào command log để xuất thành shell script.
facts.quote: Anything destructive (stop a service, remove a file, restart a container, replace a crontab) shows the exact command before it runs. The command log records everything Davish ran on your behalf

facts.fact: Ngược lại với Davish, các panel quản trị web truyền thống như 1Panel bắt buộc phải chạy script cài đặt cài cắm trực tiếp lên server và mở port web.

caveats: Bộ cài máy tính của Davish chưa được ký số chính thức (code signed), khiến macOS Gatekeeper và Windows SmartScreen hiển thị cảnh báo chặn trong lần mở đầu tiên.
Trên Linux sử dụng driver đồ họa độc quyền của NVIDIA, khả năng tăng tốc phần cứng GPU đang bị tắt mặc định do lỗi màn hình trắng; cần biến môi trường DAVISH_WEBVIEW_GPU=always để thử bật lại.
Server bắt buộc phải có sẵn các tiện ích CLI tương ứng (systemd, docker, crontab, nginx) thì các ứng dụng liên quan trên giao diện Davish mới hoạt động.

Nguồn cung cấp không có thông tin về dự án web console Cockpit của Red Hat/Fedora (kho nguồn jlcodes99/cockpit-tools thực chất là công cụ quản lý tài khoản AI IDE, không phải bảng điều khiển Linux Cockpit).
gaps: Mức độ tiêu thụ RAM và CPU thực tế của client Davish trên máy người dùng khi mở đồng thời nhiều terminal và theo dõi nhiều server cùng lúc.
Khả năng so sánh trực tiếp hiệu năng và tính năng với Linux Cockpit chính thức của Red Hat (về độ trễ SSH so với WebSocket trên port 9090 của Cockpit).
Tính ổn định của cơ chế truyền file kéo-thả giữa 2 server VPS khi dung lượng file lên đến hàng chục gigabyte.

## 2hjaito/davish (https://github.com/2hjaito/davish)
Description: Your server, as a desktop. A lightweight SSH client with an OS-like UI. Nothing to install on the server.
Homepage: https://davish.app
Language: Go; license: GPL-3.0; created 2026-10-26; last push 2026-11-25
Latest release: v1.15.1 (2026-11-24)
README (start):
# Davish

**A desktop for your Linux servers.**
Terminal, files, services, Docker, logs, cron, nginx, ports, a browser, disk, login security, SSH keys, packages and git over plain SSH, in one place that feels like an operating system.
Nothing to install on the server.

[](https://github.com/2hjaito/davish/stargazers)
[](https://github.com/2hjaito/davish/releases)
[](https://github.com/2hjaito/davish/releases/latest)
[](https://github.com/2hjaito/davish/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

[](https://discord.com/invite/eG5txdWaqr)

**English** · [Tiếng Việt](README.vi.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · **[davish.app](https://davish.app)**

  

## Why Davish

- **Open it and you're in.** No login screen, no web panel: Davish connects to the server you used last with your SSH key and puts you on its desktop. Nothing extra listens on the server, so there is no new port to open or protect.
- **Agentless.** Davish only needs `sshd` and SFTP. Everything runs from your machine over SSH; nothing is copied to, installed on or left behind on the server.
- **You see every command.** Anything destructive (stop a service, remove a file, restart a container, replace a crontab) shows the exact command before it runs. The command log records everything Davish ran on your behalf, and exports the changes as a shell script you can read and run again.
- **Secrets stay in your keychain.** Passwords and passphrases live only in the OS keychain. A `sudo` password is never saved: when root is needed, Davish asks for it once per session, keeps it in memory only, forgets it after 15 minutes unused and hands it to sudo on stdin, or you run the command in a terminal yourself.
- **Locks when you step away.** A lock password of its own, Touch ID on macOS; it locks when the machine wakes, after idle time or with `⌘L`. Sessions keep running behind the lock, but nothing reaches a server until you unlock.
- **Many servers, one desktop.** Each server is a workspace (`⌘1`…`⌘9`) that remembers its own windows. Copy files between servers by dragging them. Give a server a tag (`prod`, `staging`…) and a group, so a red `prod` stays on screen and servers sit in folders.
- **Updates itself.** A new version shows its changes with Update, Later and Skip this version; Davish downloads it, checks its signature and restarts into it. No reinstalling.
- **English, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese or Spanish.** Pick the language in Settings; the first time, Davish follows your system's. Spanish is new: corrections are welcome in [#124](https://github.com/2hjaito/davish/issues/124).
- **Your `~/.ssh/config` works, and so does your Ansible inventory.** Import their hosts in one go, keys and `ProxyJump` included, a whole Ansible group at a time; Davish only reads the files. Servers behind a bastion connect through it, each hop with its own host key check, and the whole chain reconnects on its own.

## Features

**On the server**

- [Terminal](FEATURES.md#terminal): tabs, GPU rendering, color schemes, an optional powerline prompt
- [Saved commands](FEATURES.md#saved-commands): your frequent commands, typed into Terminal in one click
- [Command log](FEATURES.md#command-log): every command Davish ran, exported as a script that runs the changes again over ssh
- [Files](FEATURES.md#files): Finder-style SFTP, drag and drop, copy between servers, search names and contents on the server, hold a file for a ring of actions
- [Editor](FEATURES.md#editor): CodeMirror with atomic saves, backups and options
- [Logs](FEATURES.md#logs): journal, files and containers, live, and search their whole history on the server
- [Monitor](FEATURES.md#monitor): CPU, memory, disks, network, GPUs, processes, on Linux and Windows servers
- [All servers](FEATURES.md#all-servers): every server's health and alerts in one window, in folders by group and filtered by state, group or tag, a map of what each one serves, and one command run on several servers, a terminal tab each

**Services and apps**

- [Services](FEATURES.md#services): systemd units, status, journal
- [Docker](FEATURES.md#docker): one card per compose project (or a table), images and layers, volumes
- [Cron](FEATURES.md#cron): schedules in plain words
- [Nginx](FEATURES.md#nginx): sites, `nginx -t` before reload, TLS expiry
- [Packages](FEATURES.md#packages): updates with security fixes first, runtimes; one-click install command when Docker, nginx, git or a database is missing
- [Database](FEATURES.md#database): MariaDB/MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and SQLite; find, create, dump and restore, read SQLite tables, MongoDB login kept in the keychain
- [Git](FEATURES.md#git): status, diffs, commit graph, fetch and pull
- [Shortcuts](FEATURES.md#desktop-shortcuts): drag `deploy.sh` onto the desktop, double-click to run, with a stop button

**Network and security**

- [Ports & tunnels](FEATURES.md#ports--tunnels): listening ports, tunnels to `127.0.0.1`
- [Browser](FEATURES.md#browser): open the server's `localhost:3000` inside Davish
- [Disk](FEATURES.md#disk): where the space goes as a tree, what could not be measured and why, delete and clean up
- [Security](FEATURES.md#security): failed logins per hour and by address, users targeted, open sessions, ufw, fail2ban
- [SSH keys](FEATURES.md#ssh-keys): authorized_keys, deploy keys, your own keys
- [~/.ssh/config, Ansible and ProxyJump](FEATURES.md#sshconfig-ansible-and-proxyjump): import hosts from ssh config or an INI inventory, connect through a bastion

**The desktop**

- [Spotlight & Launchpad](FEATURES.md#spotlight--launchpad): open anything with `⌘K`, every app by group
- [Menu bar and help](FEATURES.md#menu-bar-and-help): every command and shortcut, a `?` on each app
- [App lock](FEATURES.md#app-lock): Touch ID or a password, locks on wake
- [Updates](FEATURES.md#updates): one click to a new version, signature checked
- [Light and dark](FEATURES.md#light-and-dark): follows your system, or pick one
- [Language](FEATURES.md#language): English, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese or Spanish

  
    
    
  
  
    
    
  

**[Every app in detail, with screenshots →](FEATURES.md)**

> Screenshots show demo data from the browser preview.

## Install

Prebuilt apps for macOS (universal), Windows and Linux are attached to each [release](https://github.com/2hjaito/davish/releases).

- **macOS 12 or later.** Open `Davish-…-macos-universal.pkg` to install into Applications. The app is not signed yet, so macOS blocks it the first time: click **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway** next to the line about Davish (again for `Davish.app` if it is blocked). Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` on the file.
- **Windows 10 or later.** Run `Davish-…-windows-amd64-setup.exe`; it installs the WebView2 runtime if it is missing. Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher: choose **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- **Linux** with GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1. The window is drawn on the GPU, WebKitGTK's own default, except on the proprietary NVIDIA driver, where it stays off until it has been tested: start Davish with `DAVISH_WEBVIEW_GPU=always` to try it (Davish then sets `WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1`, the usual fix for a blank window there, unless you set it yourself) and tell us how it went in [#185](https://github.com/2hjaito/davish/issues/185). If the window stays blank or flickers on any machine, start it with `DAVISH_WEBVIEW_GPU=never`; the app log (`~/.cache/davish/logs`) has a `linux webview gpu` line saying what was chosen and why.

### What the server needs

| Feature | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Everything | OpenSSH server with the SFTP subsystem |
| Services, Logs (journal) | systemd; to read system logs, a user in the `adm` or `systemd-journal` group |
| Docker | the `docker` CLI; a user in the `docker` group (Davish offers the install command when it is missing) |
| Cron | `crontab` |
| Nginx | nginx with `sites-available` / `sites-enabled` or `conf.d` |

Actions that need root (stopping a system service, editing a root-owned file) show the exact command first, then run through `sudo` with the password asked once per session, or go to a terminal with `sudo` typed in. Nothing runs as root silently, and what could lock you out of the server stays in the terminal.

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `⌘K` | Spotlight |
| `⌘1` … `⌘9` | Switch server workspace |
| `⌘W` · `⌘M` | Close · minimize window |
| `⌘,` | Settings |
| `⌘S` | Save in the Editor |
| `⌘F` · `⌘[` · `⌘]` · `⌘↑` | Files: search, back, forward, up |
| `⌘U` · `⌘D` | Files: upload, download |
| `⌘⌥S` | Files: copy the selection to another server |
| `⌘⌥L` | Transfers window |

On Windows and Linux, use `Ctrl` instead of `⌘`. Inside a terminal, `Ctrl` shortcuts go to the shell.

## Build from source

Requirements: Go 1.27+, Node.js LTS, [Wails](https://wails.io) v2.17 (`go install github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails@v2.17.0`, then `wails doctor`), golangci-lint v2, and Docker for the integration tests. On Linux also `libgtk-3-dev` and `libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev` (build with `-tags webkit2_41`).

```bash
make frontend-install   # first time only
wails dev               # run with hot reload
wails build             # package into build/bin/
```

### Tests

```bash
make check              # go vet, golangci-lint, go test, svelte-check, eslint, prettier, vitest

make sshd-up            # two throwaway SSH servers in Docker (127.0.0.1:2222 and :2223)
make test-integration   # real SSH, SFTP, systemd, Docker, cron and nginx against them
make sshd-down
```

The integration tests only ever talk to the containers in `test/sshd/`, never to a real server.

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Backend | Go · Wails v2 · `golang.org/x/crypto/ssh` · `pkg/sftp` · `go-keyring` |
| Frontend | Svelte 5 (runes) · TypeScript strict · Vite |
| Components | xterm.js · CodeMirror 6 · icons from [davi-icons](https://github.com/2hjaito/davi-icons) |

## Changelog

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## License

Davish is free software under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE). Contributions need the [Contributor License Agreement](CLA.md); see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). The Davish name and logo are not covered by the license: see [TRADEMARKS.md](TRADEMARKS.md).

## Code signing policy

Free code signing for the Windows builds is provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). Team roles, what is signed and what Davish sends over the network: [CODE_SIGNING.md](CODE_SIGNING.md).

If davish saves you time, a ⭐ on GitHub helps a lot!

## 功能概览

### 1. 仪表盘 (Dashboard)

全新的可视化仪表盘，为您提供一站式的状态概览：

- **十六平台支持**：同时展示 Antigravity IDE、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Windsurf、Kiro、Cursor、Grok CLI、CodeBuddy、CodeBuddy CN、Qoder、Trae、TraeWork、Trae CN、TraeWork CN、Zed 与 ZCode 的账号状态
- **配额监控**：实时查看各模型剩余配额、重置时间
- **快捷操作**：一键刷新、一键唤醒
- **可视化进度**：直观的进度条展示配额消耗情况

> 

> 界面截图更新于 2026-11-02，使用 Cockpit Tools v1.3.78 实机拍摄；账号信息已隐藏。

### 2. Antigravity 账号管理

- **统一账号入口**：从账号页打开启动弹框，选择 Antigravity、Antigravity IDE 或官方 CLI（`agy`）。可以仅切号，也可以切号后启动。CLI 支持指定工作目录。
- **共享登录**：IDE 2.6 起，默认 IDE、采用系统凭据的 App 和使用 Google 登录的 `agy` 可以共用登录凭据。旧版 IDE 使用独立的本地登录状态。
- **多种导入**：支持 OAuth 授权、Refresh Token、插件同步
- **唤醒任务**：定时唤醒 AI 模型，提前触发配额重置周期

#### 2.1 Antigravity 应用多开

在同一个多开页面内可以分别管理 App 和 IDE 实例。点击实例的启动按钮，可选择对应客户端的桌面实例，也可在终端中启动 CLI。

使用独立 SQLite 登录状态的旧版 IDE 支持多账号多实例并行运行。IDE 2.6 起采用共享登录，独立实例目录仅隔离项目和本地设置。

- **独立账号**：使用独立登录的旧版 IDE 可以为各实例绑定不同账号
- **并行项目**：多实例同时处理不同任务/项目
- **参数隔离**：支持自定义实例目录与启动参数

> 

### 3. Codex 账号管理

- **专属支持**：专为 Codex 优化的账号管理体验
- **配额展示**：清晰展示 Hourly 和 Weekly 配额状态

- **ChatGPT 官方授权**：在“API 服务 → 管理成员（添加账号）”中主动选择官方通道，可在独立弹框中为已有 Codex 账号绑定 OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT 授权。打开后自动准备并显示授权链接和手动回调输入，可复制链接、使用无痕窗口或手动提交回调；授权窗口可以取消；未加入服务的账号仅保存授权，不会自动加入。卡片和添加账号列表以紧凑的「官」标识显示官方授权绑定状态；有效绑定始终高亮，不受是否加入 API 服务影响，服务成员状态单独显示。API 服务选择“官方优先”后，优先使用已绑定的官方授权；遇到可安全重试的授权拒绝、通道或连接异常时，先尝试同账号原有的本地 OAuth 通道，再沿用当前 Key 范围内的账号池规则。“仅本地”保留明确选择；回退不解除授权，仍执行账号、模型、额度、并发与代理限制。已输出内容或执行状态不明的请求不重放。资格拒绝会暂停官方通道，检查或重新授权后可恢复；临时错误按退避时间重新尝试官方。官方通道按默认速度发送，不传递 Fast/超快等速度覆盖；此适配不视为授权拒绝，也不触发回退或暂停模型。若随后因真实异常回退本地，则保留原始速度选择，由本地上游决定是否支持。请求记录显示原始速度、官方默认速度适配、源账号、实际拒绝、预检或暂停跳过、本地尝试、上游请求 ID 与最终结果；上游回报的档位单独保留，不据此推断实际加速。鹈鹕测智和手动、定时唤醒优先使用原账号绑定的官方第三方授权，未绑定时沿用原通道，不依赖 API 服务是否启动或加入集合。测智与唤醒在已绑定但失效时仍提示处理授权，不静默改用原凭据，不换号或重复生成。服务成员始终使用原账号，成员弹框在账号名和优先级之间用下拉选择“官方优先 / 仅本地”，其余字段位置不变；未授权时选择官方会打开授权弹框，成功后更新草稿，取消保持原方式。勾选和保存集合均不弹引导，保存时统一提交成员与接入方式，关闭弹框仍保留已完成的账号授权。本版本取消启动、页面进入和普通账号添加时的官方授权自动提示及新功能提醒；没有官方授权时默认使用本地网关，已有明确接入方式仍保留。后续可在“API 服务 → 管理成员（添加账号）”中选择接入方式或进入授权管理，统计区和总览工具栏不再单独放入口。名称、套餐、额度和分组始终沿用原账号资料。不改变原 Codex 客户端登录、切号或实例绑定；两套凭据独立加密保存并自动刷新。首次授权完成后直接保存并绑定；授权及加入流程无需选择模型、唤醒或发送测试推理。移除 API 服务成员会保留授权和上次接入方式，重新加入时直接复用，必要时自动续期。授权作为原账号的附加能力，列表只保留“授权/管理授权”，管理操作打开独立弹框；管理与重新授权不会自动加入服务。切换接入方式保留服务成员及 Key 范围和优先级；解除官方授权时明确选择改用本地网关或暂停，成员继续保留。暂停仅影响当前 API 服务，Rust 引擎会阻止该成员处理新请求，不改客户端登录；只有显式移出服务才移除成员。检查授权不会生成回复；官网撤销后会在检查、请求或续期时识别，不提供实时撤销通知。官方通道生图固定禁止。Rust 原生引擎通过官方公共 Responses HTTP/SSE 调用，支持本地 function/custom 工具、客户端工具发现和结果回传；工具由客户端执行，网关不代为执行本地操作。客户端 WebSocket 由本地网关转为 HTTP/SSE，连续对话仅使用经过调用者与账号归属校验的本地历史，未知 `previous_response_id` 仍需补齐完整 `input`。套餐通道不提供 compact、音频或官方未开放的托管工具。未知订阅不显示 Free；本地请求与 Token 统计仅代表本服务用量，剩余套餐额度和授权在 ChatGPT 设置中查看与管理。
- **自动能力兜底**：当前账号不支持请求能力时，API 服务自动在当前 Key 已授权的账号池中寻找兼容账号，无需单独开启或填写备用名单。候选继续受模型映射、配额及并发限制；未知能力先由当前上游处理，不发起付费探测。换号会发送必要的对话内容并消耗目标账号额度，请求详情保留相关证据。仅对明确执行前拒绝、历史完整且可安全迁移的请求换号；不重放已输出或执行状态不明的请求，不丢弃私有文件、向量库、容器引用或不兼容密文。Files、向量库和容器管理接口不属于此功能。
- **Claude 模型网关**：在 Codex「模型供应商」选择 Anthropic 协议，填写网关地址与 Key，选择 `x-api-key` 或 Bearer 鉴权；可从剪贴板导入 Claude Code settings 或桌面端 Gateway 配置，获取或手动填写模型目录。将对应 API Key 账号加入 API 服务后，模型会进入服务目录及接管的 Codex 模型选择器。Claude 协议行为参考 CLIProxyAPI `9717e325`：Rust 引擎支持流式回复、客户端工具发现、function/custom/namespace 与 MCP 工具回传、网页搜索结果及引用回放，以及 `/responses/compact` 和会话内压缩。搜索结果按调用方、账号与会话缓存，便于在 Codex 保存历史时缺少专有字段的情况下继续回放；压缩使用当前 Claude 模型生成摘要并保存为可继续使用的状态。终端、文件修改和多 Agent 等客户端工具仍由 Codex 执行并受其权限控制。结构化输出采用格式指令适配，不保证严格 JSON Schema 约束；网页搜索需要上游开放相应工具，Claude 协议适配本身不会增加生图等上游未提供的服务端能力。
- **API 服务**：统一由宿主内的 Rust 引擎运行，支持 Responses HTTP/SSE/WebSocket、上下文压缩及 Chat Completions、Claude、Gemini、Ollama 协议兼容。旧 Go/legacy 选择自动迁移，保留账号池、代理、设置、端口、API Key 与历史记录；实例网关继续按 profile 隔离。已移除 Go 引擎和切换入口，不再依赖 Go 工具链或 sidecar。
- **请求身份对照**：Rust 的请求记录「详情」可对照客户端原始 `Session-Id`、`Thread-Id`，以及每次上游尝试使用的请求头、账号和传输方式。关闭或清除正文快照仍保留这些本地诊断信息；客户端未提供与历史未采集分别显示，不按当前配置补填旧记录。这些头值不代表上游已接收请求。
- **自动续接上下文**：Rust 默认自动尝试续接历史对话，支持切换账号，缺少本地归属记录不再单独阻断请求。调用方、账号池权限及 profile 隔离继续生效。完整 Responses 历史原样保留，包括 reasoning、compaction、工具与子 Agent 密文及 `item.id`／`call_id`；不解密、不丢弃，也不以摘要替代。完整自包含 `input` 可在授权目标账号建立新的上游 Session／Thread，保留客户端 Thread；增量请求继续使用有效上游状态、完整检查点或 WebSocket 历史，缺失上下文或上游明确拒绝时仍可能失败并保留原历史。Rust 在转发完整官方 Agent 通信工具调用前登记消息密文归属；缺少记录的历史通信密文也自动尝试续接，新的续接归属仅在有效完整响应后保存。Rust 保留本地 `codex_native_api/identity.sqlite` 明文／密文历史缓存，实例网关使用各 profile 隔离目录内的 `native-identity.sqlite`，独立于正文诊断／快照开关。缓存上限为每个检查点 8 MiB、总计 64 MiB 和 128 个检查点，淘汰不删除会话或密文归属。重放可能增加输入 token，上游对跨账号密文的接受情况仍待真实请求验证。失败不覆盖已成功代次，已成功代次在升级和重启后保留；新的上游对话不改变目标账号身份。
- **语音反代**：支持 Codex backend 实时语音路由与 `/transcribe` 转写入口，并提供 `/v1/audio/transcriptions`、`/v1/audio/translations`、`/v1/audio/speech` 及无 `/v1` 的别名。OAuth 转写使用 ChatGPT backend：兼容入口支持 `file`、`language` 和 JSON／纯文本返回，`model` 仅作为兼容字段，实际模型由 backend 决定；字幕时间戳、流式转写及其他音频操作需使用支持相应接口的 API Key 供应商。原生 `/transcribe` 请求保留原有 multipart 参数，供应商侧未指定模型时使用 `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`。请求上限为 26 MiB，超时为 2 分钟，音频内容不写入请求快照。只处理实际发送到本地网关的请求；客户端仍直连官方转写服务或自行限制麦克风时，不会因设置模型供应商而自动改走本地网关。 OAuth 转写可能被上游拒绝（包括 `403 cloudflare challenge`），本地适配无法保证上游接受。API 服务绑定的 Codex 客户端保留原生听写入口与转写流程，是否显示和可用由客户端原生能力与设置决定；Cockpit 不接管听写或强制启用麦克风。当前官方实时语音按钮仍要求 ChatGPT 登录态；网关实时语音从账号池选择 OAuth，不要求该账号就是绑定账号，尚未开放纯 API Key 实时语音路由。

- **Curated App Store**: Features a built-in store of high-quality open-source applications, providing one-click installation and upgrade services to effortlessly extend server capabilities.
- **Enterprise-Grade Security**: Deploys applications based on container technology to effectively minimize vulnerability exposure. It also provides security features such as WAF and log auditing to ensure comprehensive server protection.
- **One-Click Data Backup**: Supports one-click backup and restoration, and integrates with various cloud storage solutions to ensure data security and prevent loss.

 #185
New issue

Description

Owner

Until now Davish has drawn its window on the CPU on Linux. It kept a Wails workaround (WebviewGpuPolicy: Never, wails#2977) that turns GPU compositing off for everyone, so every scroll, every frosted window and every shadow was a CPU repaint. Thanks to @tian2992 for spotting this in #181; it's probably a big part of the slowness discussed in #159.

#184 changes that:

Intel, AMD, NVIDIA on nouveau, VMs: the GPU is on by default (WebKitGTK's own default). WebKitGTK falls back to software by itself if it can't get GL.
Proprietary NVIDIA driver: the GPU stays off, exactly as before, because that driver is where the blank-window bug came from and none of us has an NVIDIA machine to try it on. You can turn it on yourself with DAVISH_WEBVIEW_GPU=always. Davish then also sets WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 (the usual fix for that driver), unless you've set it yourself.
Any machine: DAVISH_WEBVIEW_GPU=never turns the GPU off again if something looks wrong.

How you can help

Run the new version (or DAVISH_WEBVIEW_GPU=always ./Davish on NVIDIA) and tell us here:

Your distro, desktop, and X11 or Wayland
Your GPU and driver (for example lspci -k | grep -A3 VGA)
Whether the window shows up fine, and whether scrolling and dragging windows feel smoother than before
The linux webview gpu line from the app log in ~/.cache/davish/logs

A short "works fine on X" is already super useful. Once a few NVIDIA users report it works, we'll turn the GPU on by default for them too. Thanks! 🙏
